arguments.command:
python -c "
from parse import *
from parse import Parser

# Test R1: dt_format_to_regex
import re
# Test that the regex actually matches
pat = dt_format_to_regex('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
print('Pattern:', pat)
assert re.match(pat, '2023-01-05 10:30:45')
assert re.match(pat, '2023-1-5 10:30:45')  # single digit
print('R1: dt_format_to_regex OK')

# Test R2: public API
assert FixedTzOffset is not None
assert RepeatedNameError is not None
assert callable(date_convert)
assert callable(extract_format)
print('R2: public API OK')

# Test R3: formatter property
p = Parser('{name:d}')
f = p.formatter
assert isinstance(f, dict)
assert 'format' in f
assert 'extra_types' in f
assert 'case_sensitive' in f
print('R3: formatter OK')

# Test R4: %f with various digits
r = parse('{:ti}', '2023-01-15T10:30:45.1')
assert r[0].microsecond == 100000
r = parse('{:ti}', '2023-01-15T10:30:45.12')
assert r[0].microsecond == 120000
r = parse('{:ti}', '2023-01-15T10:30:45.123')
assert r[0].microsecond == 123000
r = parse('{:ti}', '2023-01-15T10:30:45.123456')
assert r[0].microsecond == 123456
print('R4: %f various digits OK')

# Test R5: hyphens in field names
r = parse('{my-field}', 'hello')
assert r['my-field'] == 'hello'
r = parse('{my-field:}', 'hello')
assert r['my-field'] == 'hello'
print('R5: hyphens in field names OK')

# Test R6: grouping characters
r = parse('{:,d}', '1,234')
assert r[0] == 1234
r = parse('{:_d}', '1_234')
assert r[0] == 1234
# Also test in named fields
r = parse('{val:,d}', '1,234')
assert r['val'] == 1234
print('R6: grouping characters OK')

print()
print('All tests passed!')
"
